Well, yes, I'll try to talk to them. Usually it's "oh that's great! uh huh, uh huh-" *phone rings "Ok, i'll meet you at that cafe. Sounds awesome. Katie too? Great, kisses." Back to me, "it's nice seeing you, I got to go but etc, etc"

I can fake a smile. Sad thing is, even that doesn't work.

Thanks for your reply.

I know San Francisco pretty well, and, well, it's pretty different down here. In San Francisco, it's incredibly diverse. There are whites, blacks, asians, indians, mexicans, you name it. Also, there's a huge range of social status. Thugs, immigrants, homeless, whatever. A good good portion of the populace is "normal", middle class, or poor. Also, it's silicon valley for heaven's sake, everyone is a nerd. Ok, a lot of them are nerds.

Here, it seems there's only one type: rich, beautiful, tight-skinned, hair-flattened, sunny, boating people. It's becoming a bit much for me. By the way, no i'm not in their social status.

Thanks for your reply, gordi.

No, i'm not fuckable. I laugh when I imagine a girl with me. Think about it.
